title: More Stuff
description: Adds more Ores, Plants, Achievements, Biomes
body:
## More Stuff
### First Release
- Adds New OP ores
  - Cryolite
  - Blaotile
  - Uranium   
- Adds New Biomes
  - Candy Biome 
- Adds New Plants

  - Spinach Leaves

- Adds New Achievements

  - Furnace Achievement
  - Spinach Leaves Bowl Achievement  
- Version 1.02
